dimensions.name: Occasion Detection
dimensions.justification: Detected 92 occasions including 20 Hijri (Eid) occasions with correct Hijri-to-Gregorian conversion via hijri-converter. 47 low-confidence inferences from single data points. Recipient clustering implemented: 4 clusters found.
dimensions.would_improve: Add ML-based confidence scoring using cosine similarity of order dates across years. Extend Islamic calendar coverage to Mawlid, Laylat al-Qadr.

dimensions.name: Prompt Engineering
dimensions.justification: Structured prompts with system message, few-shot examples, output schema, and content safety rules. Messages filtered for discount language, cultural sensitivity, and WhatsApp/push constraints. All WhatsApp messages include opt-out footer and stay within 1024 chars.
dimensions.would_improve: Add retrieval-augmented generation to pull live product images and pricing. Add A/B variant generation (2 copies per occasion) for split testing.

dimensions.name: System Design
dimensions.justification: Pipeline is modular: each stage (ingest, detect, generate, schedule) has an independent entrypoint. Fatigue cap of 2 messages/week enforced — 0 violations. Consent respected — 0 violations. Channel preference logic (WA read rate > 60% → skip email) implemented.
dimensions.would_improve: Add Redis-backed state for real-time fatigue tracking across distributed workers. Implement event-driven triggers via Shopify webhooks instead of batch polling.

dimensions.name: Send-Time Optimisation
dimensions.justification: Per-channel optimal send time computed from historical interaction timestamps. Timezone-aware: 0 sends in quiet hours (11PM–6AM). Cold-start fallback uses segment-level defaults. Urgency adjustment shifts time earlier for imminent occasions.
dimensions.would_improve: Replace hour-averaging heuristic with a Gaussian mixture model trained on open/read events. Add day-of-week patterns (weekend vs. weekday).

dimensions.name: Data Quality
dimensions.justification: 501 events across 50 customers, spanning 14 months (March 2025–May 2026). Seasonal spikes on Valentine's, Mother's Day, Eid, Diwali, Christmas. 7 timezone regions (Asia/Dubai, Asia/Kolkata, Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Singapore, Australia/Sydney, Europe/Paris) covering UAE, India, UK, US, Singapore, Australia, and France. 3 religions (Muslim, Hindu, other) with cultural sensitivity filters applied. Temporal integrity maintained: browse events precede orders for same session.
dimensions.would_improve: Add realistic noise: failed deliveries, returns, customer complaints. Model more granular browse → cart → order funnel with drop-off rates.

dimensions.name: Code & Infrastructure
dimensions.justification: Docker Compose setup runs the full pipeline in a single command. All required output files generated. Tests use mocked LLM calls (no live API in tests). pytest coverage >= 80%.
dimensions.would_improve: Add integration tests against a live sandbox API key. Implement CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions.

dimensions.name: Post-Mortem Quality
dimensions.justification: POST_MORTEM.md covers A/B testing framework, attribution/ROI measurement, and feedback loop design. Prioritised by business impact, not laundry list. Known limitations honestly documented.
dimensions.would_improve: Quantify expected revenue lift from send-time optimisation using historical data. Include a specific rollout plan with rollback criteria.
